---
name: Tool Assessment Request
about: Request an independent security assessment of an AI tool
title: "[ASSESS] <package-name>"
labels: assessment-request
assignees: ''
---

**Package name and registry**
e.g. `npm install -g litellm` or `pip install langchain`

**Version you want assessed**
e.g. `1.40.0` — or "latest" if you want the current release

**Why are you considering this tool?**
Brief context on your use case.

**Any specific concerns?**
e.g. "it has a postinstall hook", "it calls home on startup", "I saw it in a shared Slack message"

---

*Assessments are done by the OM Open AI team on a best-effort basis. We inspect tarballs without installing. We do not assess tools that appear to be actively malicious — those should be reported directly to the registry.*
